// VendorBoard: Settings for VendorBoard, the vendor board on the map screen.

// editing: Strict JSON: no comments, no trailing commas, and a comma after every value except
// editing 2: the last in each block. Entries starting with // are notes; VendorBoard rewrites them.
// editing 3: If the file stops loading, the debug line (F11 > VendorBoard > SYSTEM) says where.
// editing 4: Delete the file to start over from the defaults.
// badges: DEFAULT (USER) FILTER - your view, the F2 preset the board starts on. Lists WHICH pills

// badges 4: WEAPON2, ARMOR2, WEAPON1, ARMOR1, WEAPON0 (plain), ARMOR0 (plain), STIMPAK, MEDS, FOOD,
// hideEmptyShops: true hides rows with nothing to show in this view; false shows them with a gray
// hideEmptyShops 2: "empty shop" / "no shop" pill. Menu: FILTERING > Hide rows with no stock.
// badgeStyles: Label and color of every category's pill, used by every preset, the legend and
// badgeStyles 2: grayed visited rows. {star} draws the in-game star. Compact-view labels are under
// hotkeys: Need xScal or ZFE. Values: F-keys, NUMPAD0-9, NUMPAD+, single letters/digits, INSERT,
// hotkeys 2: HOME, PAGEUP ... "" turns a key off. Keep off F1 and F10 (Improved HUD), F8 (xScal)
// hotkeys 3: and F11 (HUD Mod Loader). presetKey = next filter preset, sortKey = next sort preset,
// hotkeys 4: viewKey = expanded > compact > hidden, showKey = optional plain hide/show.
// position: dock left (grows right) or right (grows left); anchor top (grows down) or bottom
// position 2: (grows up). Docked right, the columns are mirrored unless mirror is false.

// positions 2: y 0 (top) to 1080 (bottom). Each places the board corner that stays put while it grows.
// positions 3: origin screen keeps each corner's distance from its screen edges on any monitor.
// positions 4: origin stage uses raw HUD coordinates (21:9: left edge about -320, right about 2240).
// text 2: textSize = rows and header, smallTextSize = legend, filter list and hotkeys line
// text 3: (menu: UI > Text size). scaleColumns: column widths are for size 16 and scale with it.
// columns: Column widths. The panel keeps these widths whatever a filter shows; only a long filter
// columns 2: name in the header can widen it. vendorGrow lets the shop column widen up to vendorMax.
// columns 3: nameMaxChars cuts long player names with an ellipsis.
// nameFormat: Player name text: {name} plus tags, each replaced by its nameTags text when it applies
// rows: minRows reserves space so the panel height stays put (0 = off). maxRows caps the list.
// rows 2: wrapRows (e.g. 12) lays rows out in side-by-side blocks; columnRows is the block size
// rows 3: used by the menu's UI > Two columns.
// viewMode: expanded or compact at start (viewKey and the menu switch it live). compact holds the
// viewMode 2: settings that replace the ones above while the compact view is on; compactLabels are

// hudModes 2: ContainerMode ... allowOverlay lets showKey toggle it outside those modes.
// show: Header (SERVER 23/24  FILTER  SORT), column titles, level, estimated travel cost (~ =
// show 2: estimate, free for team camps) or raw distance and compass direction, then the legend,
// show 3: filter list and hotkeys lines under the table (menu: UI). debug = diagnostics line
// confirm: How menu changes are confirmed: toast = VendorBoard's own popup at toastPosition (16:9
// confirm 2: units from the top-left, fixed wherever the board is docked), hud = the game's
// caps: Travel cost = round(distance / perUnit), at least min; team camps are free. Clicking a
// caps 2: camp on the map reads the game's real price and calibrates perUnit. useFlyoutCost

// visited: Camps you have stood in (within visitedRadius map units) are grayed: rows faded to
// visited 2: visitedAlpha, pills drawn in visitedPillColor with visitedTint of the category color
// visited 3: (0 = flat gray, 1 = full color). hideVisited hides them instead (FILTERING > Hide visited).

// rememberChoices 2: while no other mod, such as Improved HUD, uses ZFE's storage). false: menu changes

// badgeStyle 2: pillWrap continues pills that do not fit on the next line of the row; false folds
// badgeStyle 3: them into one +N pill (pillOverflowColor, also used for empty shop / no shop).
